subject.title: [Feature]: feat: trigger session-memory hook on /compact command

question: Should bundled session-memory archive on all `session:compact:before` lifecycle events, only on manual `/compact`, or should memoryFlush/continuity remain the intended compaction-memory path?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent contract affects manual versus automatic compaction, transcript retention, lifecycle event payloads, and overlap with memoryFlush and continuity work.

options.title: Use Lifecycle Archive
options.body: Wire session-memory to `session:compact:before` with the needed transcript/session context so both manual and automatic compaction can capture pre-compaction state under one lifecycle contract.

options.title: Manual Compact Only
options.body: Emit or handle a `/compact`-specific archive path if maintainers want only user-invoked compaction to behave like `/new` and `/reset`.

options.title: Keep MemoryFlush/Continuity
options.body: Leave session-memory scoped to reset/new events and document memoryFlush or continuity snapshots as the intended compaction preservation mechanism.

recommendation.title: Use Lifecycle Archive
recommendation.body: Wire session-memory to `session:compact:before` with the needed transcript/session context so both manual and automatic compaction can capture pre-compaction state under one lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the compaction lifecycle hook surface most directly involved in the product contract choice.
